Eight archives belong in this folder (../README.txt and ../source-archives.json describe them):

  bowtie2-2.4.2.tar.xz    coreutils-8.32.tar.xz   diffutils-3.10.tar.xz   gawk-5.1.0.tar.xz
  grep-3.7.tar.xz         grep-3.11.tar.xz        pcre2-10.42.tar.bz2     sed-4.8.tar.xz

The GNU General Public License asks whoever passes these programs on – and a public web site does –
to offer their source code with them. Keep the archives here, with the site.

If this folder holds only this file: the practical was handed over as two zip files, because the
archives are large (25 MB together). They are in ai-agents-practical-sources.zip. Unzip it and move
the eight archives into this folder. Their checksums are in ../SHA256SUMS:

  cd .. && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
